facts.text: Jon expressed admiration for a photo of Gina and others dancing, noting their passion and recalling his own love for performing.

evidence.quote: Wow, that's an awesome pic! You guys look great and passionate about dancing. Reminds me how much I love performing.

facts.text: Gina acknowledged Jon's admiration and encouraged him to continue pursuing his dreams.

evidence.quote: Thanks! I'm glad the pic reminded you of your love for dancing. Keep going after your dreams!

facts.text: Jon affirmed his commitment to not giving up, citing Gina's support as a key motivator.

evidence.quote: Sure thing, Gina! Your help means a lot to me. I'm not giving up.
Thanks! I won't quit, no matter what. Your encouragement really motivates me to keep going.

facts.text: Gina expressed support for Jon, encouraging him to continue and stating she would be there for him.

evidence.quote: Go, Jon! I'm here for you. Keep going!
